newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent weakens in correction to Thursday gains.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent weakens in correction to Thursday gains.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were weaker on Friday in what dealers said was a corrective reaction to strong gains on Thursday.

September Brent was 22 cents a barrel lower at $18.47 at 0955 GMT, while August gas oil was $1.75 a tonne weaker at $165.25. Both contracts were sitting just above, or at, good technical support levels.
"This is a result of over-hype yesterday - there is some profit taking," one dealer at the IPE said.
Brent crude rose 38 cents on Thursday amid fears of storm disruption to oil production in the Gulf of Mexico.
